item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct 2024 evidence that Modi rejected a credible ceasefire, blocked peace talks, or refused a lawful settlement when one was on offer. I also found no direct evidence of a Modi-led post-conflict reconciliation program beyond Ukraine-facing humanitarian, trade, and cultural cooperation.
